test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - GA (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Who among the following is NOT appointed by the President of India?

options.text: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Solicitor General of India.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Whereas attorney general for India is appointed by the President under Article 76(1) of the Constitution, the solicitor general of India is appointed to assist the attorney general along with four additional solicitors general by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.
 
• The proposal for the appointment of the Solicitor General commonly proceeds to the level of **Joint Secretary/Law Secretary in the Department of Legal Affairs.**
 
• The **Solicitor General of India (SGI)** is subordinate to the Attorney General for India.
 
• They are the **second-highest law officer in the country**, helps the Attorney General, and is helped by the Additional Solicitors General of India (Addl. SGIs).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** President** shall allot a person, that one is qualified to be appointed a judge of the Supreme Court, to be **Attorney-General for India.**
 
• The **Comptroller and Auditor General** are one of the few offices directly scheduled by the** President of India.**
 
• The** President** approves the appointments of **Ambassadors/High Commissioners** based on the recommendations of the Prime Minister and the External Affairs Minister.​
